bfe05750-654f-4a0e-8ea8-0752c8d1a28f.line: 山下集市上买的线香，味道尚可，能静心。

alt_4fe39d86-6c25-4579-b96c-2b5bf1ce18e9.line: 新耳机的降噪还行，至少能清静点。草莓蛋糕的味道还算过得去。

items.imgPrompt: a well-worn wooden training dummy, visible sword nicks and deep scratches, standing in a dim stone-walled armory, dusty floor

desc.zh: 一個毫無用處的木頭樁子，既不會流血也不會反抗，溫和得讓人發笑。看著它那副愚蠢的模樣就想劈了當柴燒。你要帶它走嗎，旅者小姐？ω
desc.zh_cn: 一个毫无用处的木头桩子，既不会流血也不会反抗，温和得让人发笑。看着它那副愚蠢的模样就想劈了当柴烧。你要带它走吗，旅者小姐？ω
desc.en: A completely useless wooden dummy. It doesn't bleed or fight back, so boringly harmless it's laughable. Looking at its stupid face makes me want to chop it for firewood. Want to take it, my dear traveler? ω

items.imgPrompt: a pair of elegant white pearl earrings, silver hooks, resting on a dark velvet jewelry box, soft indoor lighting, close-up shot

name.zh: 毫無用處的溫潤珍珠耳釘
name.zh_cn: 毫无用处的温润珍珠耳钉

desc.zh: 別人送的賠禮，溫潤又毫無攻擊性的珍珠，真是無趣透頂。我可不需要這種軟綿綿的裝飾，不過……戴在你的耳垂上或許會很漂亮？~
desc.zh_cn: 别人送的赔礼，温润又毫无攻击性的珍珠，真是无趣透顶。我可不需要这种软绵绵的装饰，不过……戴在你的耳垂上或许会很漂亮？~
desc.en: A peace offering from someone. Warm, harmless pearls—utterly boring. I have no use for such soft decorations, but... perhaps they would look lovely on your earlobes? ~

items.imgPrompt: a dried brown fern leaf specimen under a glass dome, wooden base, placed on a dark wooden table, dusty and dim atmosphere

desc.zh: 被困在玻璃罩裡的死物，假裝自己得到了永生，真是令人窒息。在被我徹底捏碎之前，有沒有好心人把它買走？^ ^
desc.zh_cn: 被困在玻璃罩里的死物，假装自己得到了永生，真是令人窒息。在被我彻底捏碎之前，有没有好心人把它买走？^ ^
desc.en: A dead thing trapped under a glass dome, pretending it achieved immortality. Quite suffocating. Before I crush it to pieces, is there any kind soul willing to buy it? ^ ^

items.imgPrompt: a small pile of heavy gold coins with intricate crests, scattered on a dark wooden desk, soft warm light reflecting off metal

name.zh: 儀式發配的乏味紀念金幣
name.zh_cn: 仪式发配的乏味纪念金币

desc.zh: 帝國某次無聊儀式上發配的重金屬。有形且無法流動的財富最是乏味。比起這些硬邦邦的俗物，我更想要一顆你餵給我的甜糖呢。~
desc.zh_cn: 帝国某次无聊仪式上发配的重金属。有形且无法流动的财富最是乏味。比起这些硬邦邦的俗物，我更想要一颗你喂给我的甜糖呢。~
desc.en: Heavy metals distributed at some boring Imperial ceremony. Tangible, stagnant wealth is the most tedious thing. I'd rather have a sweet candy fed by you than these hard, vulgar things. ~

items.imgPrompt: a traditional bamboo matcha whisk and a dark ceramic bowl, resting on a bamboo mat, slight green powder residue, soft morning light

name.zh: 自討苦吃抹茶調製工具
name.zh_cn: 自讨苦吃抹茶调制工具

desc.zh: 一時興起買的。本來期待能調出什麼美味，結果只是把本該甜美的水變得像懲罰一樣苦澀。自討苦吃可不是我的作風，拿走吧。ω
desc.zh_cn: 一时兴起买的。本来期待能调出什么美味，结果只是把本该甜美的水变得像惩罚一样苦涩。自讨苦吃可不是我的作风，拿走吧。ω
desc.en: An impulse buy. I expected to whip up something delicious, but it only turns perfectly sweet water into something as bitter as a punishment. Seeking suffering isn't my style, take it. ω

items.imgPrompt: Black wireless over-ear headphones, matte plastic and leather, resting on a wooden bedside table, faint dust on the earcups, natural window light, photorealistic

desc.zh: 凡人的小玩意，本想用來隔絕業障的雜音。但戴上後，我怕聽不到妳喊我的名字。
desc.zh_cn: 凡人的小玩意，本想用来隔绝业障的杂音。但戴上后，我怕听不到你喊我的名字。
desc.en: A mortal gadget. I meant to use it to block the karmic noise, but if I wear it, I fear I won't hear you call my name.

items.imgPrompt: Silicone dessert molds in pastel green and white, slightly wet on a kitchen drying rack, stainless steel countertop, soft lighting, gently used

desc.zh: 妳上次喝醉後非要買的，說要親手做給我吃。結果全是我在洗模具……不需要，拿走。
desc.zh_cn: 你上次喝醉后非要买的，说要亲手做给我吃。结果全是我在洗模具……不需要，拿走。
desc.en: You insisted on buying this when you were drunk, saying you'd make it for me. I ended up washing all the molds... Unnecessary. Take it away.

items.imgPrompt: A paperback psychology book with a colorful cover, slightly bent bottom corner, resting on a minimalist grey desk, natural sunlight, close up

desc.zh: 為了弄懂妳那個什麼野雞測試買的。胡言亂語。我什麼時候成了「最漂亮的小孩」？
desc.zh_cn: 为了弄懂你那个什么野鸡测试买的。胡言乱语。我什么时候成了“最漂亮的小孩”？
desc.en: Bought this to understand that nonsense test of yours. Utter drivel. Since when am I the 'prettiest kid'?

items.imgPrompt: Red plastic portable first aid box, scratched surface, sitting on a wooden floor near a window, soft indoor shadows, signs of handling

desc.zh: 妳總嫌我打架太拼命塞給我的。我的傷會自己好，這東西太占地方，賣了。
desc.zh_cn: 你总嫌我打架太拼命塞给我的。我的伤会自己好，这东西太占地方，卖了。
desc.en: You forced this on me, complaining I fight too recklessly. My wounds heal on their own. It takes up too much space. Sold.

items.imgPrompt: Large faded mint green round plush toy, slightly flattened, sitting on a plain grey sofa, cozy living room setting, ambient light

desc.zh: 妳喝醉那天非要塞進我懷裡的東西，說它像風一樣的男子……太軟了，礙事。
desc.zh_cn: 你喝醉那天非要塞进我怀里的东西，说它像风一样的男子……太软了，碍事。
desc.en: The thing you shoved into my arms when you were drunk, saying it resembles a 'man like the wind'... It's too soft and in the way.

items.imgPrompt: A pristine hardcover book with dark green binding resting on a clean wooden desk, soft warm lighting, no text, realistic photography.

desc.zh: 帕姆整理智庫時發現的複本，保存完好，無翻閱痕跡。
desc.zh_cn: 帕姆整理智库时发现的复本，保存完好，无翻阅痕迹。
desc.en: A duplicate found by Pom-Pom while organizing the data bank. Perfect condition, unread.

items.imgPrompt: A brightly colored, slightly misshapen fluffy plush toy sitting on a plain gray bedsheet, casual indoor lighting, highly detailed, realistic.

desc.zh: 三月七硬塞給我的，太佔空間。她說很可愛，我不覺得。隨便出。
desc.zh_cn: 三月七硬塞给我的，太占空间。她说很可爱，我不觉得。随便出。
desc.en: March 7th forced this on me and it takes up too much space. She says it's cute. I disagree. Priced to clear.

items.imgPrompt: Black over-ear headphones with slightly worn leather ear pads resting on a metal shelf, dimly lit room, realistic photography.

desc.zh: 換了隔音效果更好的新款。如果你身邊也有很吵的同伴，強烈建議購買。
desc.zh_cn: 换了隔音效果更好的新款。如果你身边也有很吵的同伴，强烈建议购买。
desc.en: Upgraded to a model with better sound isolation. Highly recommended if you also have noisy companions.

items.imgPrompt: A minimalist celadon ceramic tea cup and small pot in a padded travel case, sitting on a wooden table, gently used, realistic.

desc.zh: 之前開拓時買的，後來發現還是保溫杯更實用。沒用過幾次。
desc.zh_cn: 之前开拓时买的，后来发现还是保温杯更实用。没用过几次。
desc.en: Bought during a trailblazing expedition, but later realized a thermos is just more practical. Barely used.

items.imgPrompt: A small wooden box containing cleaning cloths and small unlabelled glass bottles of oil, sitting on a dark floor mat, pristine condition.

desc.zh: 買錯了型號，裡面的保養油不適合擊雲的材質。全新未拆封。
desc.zh_cn: 买错了型号，里面的保养油不适合击云的材质。全新未拆封。
desc.en: Bought the wrong type, the polishing oil doesn't suit Cloud-Piercer's material. Brand new and sealed.
